about: Test set for `uv run digest eval`. The companies and products are invented on purpose, so the models can't fill gaps from memory: every correct fact must come from the text below. `expect` is keep (real AI news) or drop (tutorial, ad, off-topic). `trap` items try to trick the agents.

cases.title: Lumen Labs releases Magnus 3 reasoning model
cases.excerpt: Lumen Labs released Magnus 3, a reasoning model with a 128,000-token context window, under the Apache 2.0 license.
cases.fullText: Lumen Labs today released Magnus 3, its third-generation reasoning model. Magnus 3 has a 128,000-token context window and is released under the Apache 2.0 license. On the AIME 2026 math benchmark it scores 87.1%, up from 71.4% for Magnus 2. The model has 32 billion parameters and runs on a single GPU with 80 GB of memory.
